children: Clearpool has opened a governance vote on Snapshot on the proposed migration of its token from CPOOL to CLEAR. The vote is live for one week, and CPOOL holders decide whether the entire token supply migrates to the new CLEAR asset.

The outcome directly determines the asset's future form, making this a defining token-economic decision for the protocol. If the vote passes, the swap path from CPOOL to CLEAR becomes binding, and holders who do not participate in the migration would hold the legacy token.

Because the result shapes the token's structure, CPOOL may face repricing pressure while the vote is open. Holders can review the proposal details and voting rules on Snapshot before the one-week window closes.
🖊️ The CPOOL → CLEAR governance vote is now LIVE on Snapshot, open for one week. This is the vote on the token migration from CPOOL to CLEAR.

title: Clearpool: governance vote opens on CPOOL to CLEAR token migration - 25 Sep 2026 to 02 Oct 2026
